doc.title: Joe Ascione interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001

title: Rich's personality and being self-taught
summary: Rich's moods ranged from good to bad, and his strong personality shaped his playing. Ascione calls him self-taught but gifted in every way.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: I’ve heard people say that he had extreme, could be extremely nice and then could be extremely not nice. Did you ever witness either one of those things?

Yeah. All shades. I saw it go from good to bad and back to bad and into good. You know I really appreciate strong personalities, because you know where you stand. I mean there’s a fine line between strong personality and psychosis being a little askew. But people are people.

But I think somebody who played at that level is going to have a strong personality. People play their personalities. I think people play their personalities. You meet someone who’s got a wishy-washy handshake and kind of — they’re going to play, their horn like that. You meet somebody like, well talking about Buddy Rich, there’s going to be some fire behind the kit.
He was pretty self taught musically, wasn’t he?

Yeah. I think he’s one of those guys who were the creators. You know two thousand years ago people sat at the foot of someone, you know, the mentor. And you absorbed and you studied in the real world of institutions and university studying. But it wasn’t about, you know, go change your schedule so biology is Tuesday and Thursday. So I think, yeah, he was self taught but he created. I mean he used to watch Billy Gladstone and all these great drummers in the pits at Radio City and, you know, he sat and

absorbed. And he also had, all the ingredients were right. The quick wit, the great talent, the genetic and physiological capabilities, the great ear. Just all the ingredients were strong. It’s like a great athlete that has it all. You know I remember reading about Schwarzenegger, when he was a world class body builder. But he was on the like championship soccer teams over in Europe. And genetically he was together, but he was a great athlete. So I think when you have all of those strong ingredients you go far. So yeah, Buddy Rich was self taught in that sense, but then we have schools to study people like that. So then you say well I’m educated and he wasn’t? No, you can’t say that.
